jsonld_raw.name: FIRENZE PER DUE VIOLET & MOCHA PARFUM 100ML (3.4 FL.OZ)
jsonld_raw.description:
FIRENZE PER DUE VIOLET & MOCHA PARFUM 100ML (3.4 FL.OZ). The Art of Becoming, a collection inspired by the journey toward your most authentic self. A conversation that lingers over coffee, art, and streets filled with history. It is in those unexpected encounters where you discover new ways of looking at the world and knowing yourself. The delicacy of violet blends with the richness of mocha coffee, while sandalwood and musk create an intimate, enveloping, and deeply elegant trail.

A collection created by Ms. Jo Malone CBE, founder of Jo Loves.

Amber Woody | Intimate, enveloping, and sophisticated
